rows.label: tlk43700149_01_msg0002
rows.name:
Fons Maim is hectic with preparations
for war.

rows.label: tlk43700149_01_msg0003
rows.name:
Keep a low profile so the Invidian
soldiers don't take notice of you.

rows.label: tlk43700149_01_msg0004
rows.name:
They'll probably call on us eventually
too.

rows.label: tlk43700149_01_msg0005
rows.name:
Invidia's armed forces are
essentially made up of both the
regular army and the mercenaries.

rows.label: tlk43700149_01_msg0006
rows.name:
And come wartime, us mercs'll
be swimming in gold!
